headline: COLLECTIVE MINING Hits 71m at 1.95 g/t AuEq From Surface — New Oxide Zone Traced 700m
snippet: Collective Mining (TSX: CNL) announced May 20 the discovery of a precious-metal-rich oxide zone at Northern Apollo, Guayabales Project, Colombia — 700m strike by 200m width and up to 100m depth. Best intercept: 71.20m at 1.95 g/t AuEq (0.75 g/t Au + 87 g/t Ag) from surface; metallurgical testing underway ahead of a maiden NI 43-101 resource targeted for mid-2027.

headline: Greenland Mines LANDS $35M Sarfartoq Rare Earth Deal From Neo Performance
snippet: Greenland Mines (NASDAQ: GRML) announced May 21 it is acquiring the NdPr-rich Sarfartoq carbonatite project in southwest Greenland from Neo Performance Materials for US$35M ($20M cash + $15M shares), with Neo retaining an equity stake and a 60% future offtake right. The project is 60km from an international airport with tidewater and hydroelectric access, requiring Government of Greenland regulatory approval to close.

headline: FREEGOLD VENTURES Hits 33.7 g/t Au Over 19.5m Including 263.9 g/t at Golden Summit, Alaska
snippet: Freegold Ventures (TSXV: FVL) reported May 20 bonanza-grade infill results at Golden Summit, Alaska: hole GS2558 hit 33.71 g/t Au over 19.5m including 263.9 g/t over 2.4m, with GS2555 returning a bulk composite of 1.43 g/t Au over 74.9m. Higher-grade corridors are now traced for over 1.5 km as the company advances a 50,000m program toward a Pre-Feasibility Study on a 29.1 Moz resource.

headline: JUGGERNAUT Mobilizes 10,000m Inaugural Drill at Golden Triangle's Big One Discovery
snippet: Juggernaut Exploration (TSXV: JUGR) mobilized May 19 for its first-ever drill program on the Big One property in BC's Golden Triangle — 10,000m testing the Eldorado zone, where surface samples graded up to 263.7 g/t AuEq from over 400 mineralized shear-hosted veins exposed for more than 1 km of vertical relief. Free-milling gold confirmed by Colorado School of Mines; program fully funded.

headline: FIRST MINING GOLD Hits 73.4 g/t Au at Duparquet; Multi-Zone Continuity Confirmed in Quebec
snippet: First Mining Gold (TSX: FF) released May 19 final 2025 drill results from Duparquet, Quebec — best hole DUP25-056 returned 73.4 g/t Au over 1.0m within a 5.0m composite of 15.14 g/t Au. The 16,577m campaign confirmed mineralization continuity across North Zone, South Zone, and the Minuit target area.

headline: GOLD'S Safe-Haven Narrative Cracking — Dollar and Yields Pull Metal Below $4,500
snippet: As gold broke below $4,500 and tested support at its 200-day moving average on May 19, analysts at Capital.com and Morgan Stanley are asking whether the metal is losing its safe-haven crown — with rising U.S. Treasury yields and a firming dollar acting as the dominant price drivers rather than geopolitical risk. The article notes silver's industrial exposure is compounding the selling pressure.

headline: SIGMA LITHIUM Shares Plunge 15% After Brazilian Court Orders $10M Collateral on Waste Dispute
snippet: Sigma Lithium (NASDAQ: SGML) filed a legal appeal May 18 after a local Aracuai court imposed a potential US$10M collateral tied to alleged waste-pile violations at its Grota do Cirilo operation — despite authorities verifying environmental compliance days earlier. Shares dropped 15%; the company called the campaign a recurring tactic timed to coincide with strong Q1 earnings.

headline: COPPER Slides to $6.23/lb as Iran War Risk Returns; Geopolitics Swamp Supply Story
snippet: Copper fell 1.01% to $6.23/lb on May 21 — erasing a 2% rally from the prior session — after Trump warned that U.S. strikes on Iran could resume within days if peace talks stalled. Analysts note that geopolitical risk sentiment, not copper's tight underlying supply fundamentals, is driving near-term price action.

headline: FRONTIER NUCLEAR Nears Engo Valley Maiden Resource — Namibia Uranium MRE Due Mid-Q3 2026
snippet: Frontier Nuclear and Minerals (NASDAQ: FNUC) confirmed May 18 that all Phase 2 assay results from 57 drill holes at its Engo Valley uranium project in Namibia are in hand, with a maiden Regulation S-K mineral resource estimate on track for mid-Q3 2026. The timing aligns with accelerating U.S. government policy support for domestic and allied nuclear fuel cycle development.

headline: CHINA Finds New Rare Earth Deposit Type in Frozen North — Sand-and-Gravel Beats Southern Clays
snippet: Chinese Academy of Sciences researchers announced May 18 a new rare earth deposit type in Heilongjiang and Jilin provinces — loose sand-and-gravel formations from freeze-thaw cycles that may be cheaper to mine and less chemically intensive than the clay-leach deposits of southern China. The discovery threatens to deepen China's rare earth dominance just as Western supply-chain alternatives are scaling up.

headline: DEBT CRISIS, Not Trade War, Is the Real Catalyst for a Historic Gold and Silver Breakout
snippet: Veteran momentum analyst Michael Oliver, via Money Metals Exchange (May 18), argues that U.S., Japanese, and European sovereign debt markets are all vulnerable to a structural break — and that precious metals are signalling a historic bull move, not a short-cycle correction. His momentum model targets silver in the $300–$500 range, citing the January 2026 all-time high at $121.64 as confirmation the structural trend is intact.
